args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring already claimed ROUND_HALF_EVEN, but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build failed because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but src/money.py implemented ROUND_HALF_UP.

- Changed `round_money` in src/money.py to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching both the FIN-212 requirement and its existing docstring.
- CI run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986.

Review requested: @alex
